content:
An ACTIVE operator with PAY can approve an authorized payment without another role-grant review. Switch the Portal to that controlled identity before it approves the request.

An accepted invitation may confer only ADMIN. A requested PAY grant becomes effective at its review event. Scope, capacity and epoch checks still apply after PAY is active; revocation invalidates earlier approvals.
